workspace._comment_qmodIncludeDirs: Only build/. This mod ships no native libraries of its own; its four dependencies are listed in mod.json with downloadIfMissing URLs and QuestPatcher fetches them. scripts/package-qmod.sh builds the archive and checks it against the manifest.

additionalData.comment: Do NOT add rapidjson-macros for RapidJSON: its restore silently produces an empty extern/includes/rapidjson-macros/shared (confirmed via a CI step that listed the restored tree). RapidJSON is vendored as plain committed headers instead -- see extern-vendor/rapidjson/include and CMakeLists.txt.

Codegen headers for Beat Saber 1.40.8_7379. NOTE: bs-cordl version numbers are NOT ordered by game version -- 1.40.1/2/3 were published as 4010/4020/4030, then 1.40.4 through 1.40.8 as 4004 through 4008. So 4008.0.0 (1.40.8) sorts BELOW 4030.0.0 (1.40.3), and a versionRange of '*' resolves to the older game. Pin this deliberately, and keep it in step with bsml below and packageVersion in mod.template.json.

bsq-ports/Quest-BSML. Supplies the settings menu registration, BSML-Lite control factories and FloatingScreen used by the overlay. 0.4.55 is the release built against bs-cordl 4008 (1.40.8); 0.5.x moves to 1.41+, so the caret range must not cross into it.
